description: This file defines a custom Android View subclass called LabelView, used to draw simple text labels with customizable text, size, and color.

classes.name: LabelView
classes.description: A custom Android View for displaying simple text labels with customizable properties.

methods.name: LabelView
methods.description: Constructor for creating LabelView from XML attributes.

methods.name: initLabelView
methods.description: Initializes paint and padding for the label view.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text to display in the label.

methods.name: setTextSize
methods.description: Sets the font size of the label text.

methods.name: setTextColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the label text.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions based on text size and padding.

methods.name: measureWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the view based on text and padding.

methods.name: measureHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the view based on text and padding.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the text onto the canvas.
